quest.texte: Find a Red GYARADOS-like Pokemon in the local lake

story: So far, Enzo's mother warned him about potential wild Pokemon attacks in tall grass. Matt visited earlier, offering P1 million if Enzo arrives at Lake Verity on time. Matt forgot his Bag and Journal. Recently, Matt mentioned a news report about the Red Gyarados, sparking his quest to find a similar Pokemon in their local lake. Next step: Chase after Matt, who was last seen heading towards Route 201.

Mom: Oh, yes! Enzo! Don't go into the tall grass. Wild Pokemon might attack you. It would be OK if you had your own Pokemon, but you don't, so...
Matt: What was that about?! Oh, hey, Enzo! Hey! I'm going to the lake! You come too! And be quick about it! OK, Enzo? I'm fining you P1 million if you're late!
